'''Ferrocarbon''' was an incredibly strong, corrosion-resistant building material made from the combination of [[Iron/Legends|iron]] and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]. It saw widespread usage on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where it was used to form the structural foundation of skyscrapers.
